'''''Blizzard 1''''' was a modified [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] which served as [[Major General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]' personal AT-AT, with increased firepower and additional armor.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Blizzard_1.png|thumb|left|200px|Blizzard 1 during the Battle of Hoth 3 ABY]]
The [[Walker/Legends|walker]] designated as ''Blizzard 1'' was a modified All Terrain Armored Transport that had been specially designed to house heat circulation systems, de-icing controls, and energy efficient environmental controls. The walker was 20 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and 22.5 meters high. It could travel at a maximum speed of 60 [[Kilometer/Legends|km/h]] and was armed with 2 heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]<ref name="SWE5" /> and 2 medium [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]].<ref name="SWE5" /> A crew of 1 [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and 1 [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]/co-pilot sat in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] along with the vehicle's [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="SWE5" /> During the battle of Hoth it carried at least 40 [[Cold weather assault trooper|snowtroopers]] deployable via as well as at least 4 snow scout troopers, two deck officers (upper and lower)<ref name="BTM" /> and 4 [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] with modifications for the cold and snowy environment.<ref name="EGVV" />

==History==
''Blizzard 1'' was an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] that was constructed at [[Camp Culroon]] a secret research base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]] between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. It was used by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] at the [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|Battle of Zaloriis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the battle, Veers was promoted to [[General/Legends|General]].<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> Veers later took control of ''Blizzard 1'' again to lead the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] in its assault upon [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], targeting and successfully destroying the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] main power generator.<ref name="SWE5" /> Immediately after destroying the shield generator, ''Blizzard 1'' was disabled when the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] Rogue 4, piloted by [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] and [[Kesin Ommis/Legends|Kesin Ommis]], crashed into its cockpit.<ref name="SWE5 novel" /> Although Veers survived the crash, albeit with serious injuries to his [[Limb/Legends|legs]] that forced him to rely on a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|repulsorlift carriage]] for the rest of his life,<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> the rest of Blizzard 1's crew perished.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]], a dying Derek Klivian crashed into ''Blizzard 1'', killing himself and Veers. This was contradicted by later sources showing both characters alive after Hoth. Later [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]]s incorporated this source by having the crash occur, with Hobbie surviving due to copious amounts of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] therapy, and Veers receiving crippling injuries. Also, a flaw in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'', prevented ''Blizzard 1'' from being toppled by snowspeeders, which has been fixed in a patch.

Veers was seen driving ''Blizzard 1'' in the 2006 video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]'' and its [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]].

==Lego==
In 2021 a LEGO version of Blizzard 1 was released as part of the Ultimate Collectors Series. The mini figure scale set depicts the walker during the events of the Battle of Hoth and includes 9 figures; General Veers, Two pilots, 4 snowtroopers, a snowtrooper commander and Luke Skywalker in his Hoth pilot outfit. As well as featuring two speeder bikes and an e-web repeating blaster cannon, the set has a very detailed interior with room for 40 Lego snowtroopers.
